name: Western Ghats Evergreen Corridor
description: A biodiversity hotspot corridor linking fragmented montane rainforest patches. Home to endemic primates, ancient Dipterocarp canopies, and vital elephant migratory paths currently disrupted by linear infrastructure.
vulnerability_notes: High fragmentation index, edge effects from estate cultivation, and canopy pollinator decline.

name: Sundarbans Mangrove Tidal Wetland
description: The world's largest contiguous halophytic mangrove forest and estuarine complex. Provides essential coastal storm buffering and nursery grounds for tidal fish and apex marine/terrestrial predators.
vulnerability_notes: Accelerating salinity intrusion due to diminished upstream river discharge, cyclone-induced levee erosion, and intensive benthic crustacean dredging.
